name: Aarhus Christmas 2019

venue.name: Fjordsgade forenings- og fritidshus
venue.address: N. J. Fjords Gade 2, 8000 Aarhus C

information:
Dette er den første konkurrence arrangeret af foreningen Speedcubing Aarhus. Udover WCA-discipliner afholder vi også 2 FunCubing-discipliner: 3x3x3 Team-Blind og 3x3x3 Med Grillhandsker.

Vi tilbyder billig [overnatning](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AarhusChristmas2019#12737-overnatning-accommodation). 

Forældre er velkomne til at byde ind, hvis de gerne vil lave en praktisk opgave under konkurrencen. Send en mail til: speedcubingaarhus@googlegroups.com
______
This is the first competition organized by Speedcubing Aarhus. In addition to the WCA events, there will also be 2 FunCubing events: 3x3x3 Team-Blind and 3x3x3 With Oven Mitts.

We offer cheap [accommodation](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AarhusChristmas2019#12737-overnatning-accommodation).

If they would like to, parents are very welcome to lend us a hand during the competition. Please mail: speedcubingaarhus@googlegroups.com
